spec.claim_summary: Buying Solana when WMA7 crosses above WMA25 and selling when WMA7 crosses below WMA25 turned 1x into 85x in 36 trades over 4 years versus 48x for buy-and-hold.
assumptions: Asset Solana mapped to Binance spot SOLUSDT.
Timeframe not stated; 1d chosen as most natural because 36 crosses in 4 years is consistent with daily WMA7/WMA25, while intraday bars would produce far more signals.
Direction is long-only spot buying and selling with full reinvestment; no shorting.
Entry is WMA(7) crosses above WMA(25) and exit is WMA(7) crosses below WMA(25), evaluated on bar closes with fill at next open.
Initial buy 4 years ago and reinvest-all compounding are starting-position and sizing details, not part of the repeatable rule; the engine starts flat with one position at a time.
Claimed 85 times interpreted as total_return_pct 8500; 4-year window inferred as 2020-08-14 to 2024-08-14 from post date 2024-08-14; test window is not part of the rule.
No stop, target, trailing stop or max hold stated; exit is solely the opposite cross.
Buy-and-hold 48x mention is background comparison, not the tested strategy.

evidence.quote: when WMA7 crossed up over WMA25
sold everything each time WMA7 crossed down over WMA25
you would have made 85 times your money
